lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Pattern consists of approximately 5-6 identifiable vertical columns of high-luminance, circular spot clusters posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into a denser, less structured arrangement of smaller spots towards the anterior head region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the primary spot columns on the mid-lateral flank, creating a grid-like arrangement where spots appear as nodes within the vertical trajectories.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring a high-intensity highlight on the superior edge and a distinct shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-luminance, elongated fusiform biological attachment (likely a remora) is present on the ventral-lateral surface near the base of the pectoral fin.
